variant: current camera + M1, no external cylinders
method: book-spine-plane inverse ray calibration + bicubic coordinate-map interpolation + bilinear image resampling
display: same display gain and transfer curve as the original; no sharpening, generative fill or reference-texture input
interpolation: bilinear intensity interpolation; magnifies existing samples only
masked: book tops, gaps and areas outside the defined spine plane
limitations: fixed aligned spine plane Z=60 mm; changed depth/pose requires recalibration
single chief ray represents each object point; finite-pupil blur is retained in the observed image
stretching pixels does not increase optical resolution
synthetic monochrome input, not a real photograph
